title: Legacy usage reporting removed
description: Basil removes legacy usage-based billing. This record covers the legacy subscription-item reporting helpers only. Scoped to migration from SDK >=17.0.0 <18.0.0 to 18.0.0.
oldBehavior: Legacy metered subscriptions accepted usage records.
newBehavior: The target SDK removes the legacy helpers. Migrate to billing meters, or separately review the documented RawRequest transition with a pinned pre-Basil API version.
migrationInstructions: Plan the meter migration and historical-usage transition before replacing reporting calls.
If deferring the meter migration, review Stripe's documented SDK-upgrade transition using RawRequest and a pre-Basil API version; this analyzer does not verify or implement that path.

evidenceSources.summary: Basil removes legacy usage-based billing. This record covers the legacy subscription-item reporting helpers only.
The tagged v18 changelog pins Basil and identifies the removed SDK helpers, subscription parameters and period fields.

review.notes: Phase 2.5: manually inspected the cited official pages and checked rule scope, selectors and version assumptions. Agent source review only; no independent human approval or runtime verification.

assumptions: The source SDK range >=17.0.0 <18.0.0 is a selected upgrade cohort, not the earliest historical affected version or an exhaustive affected range.
A static reference indicates potential migration work; it does not prove execution, deployment impact or migration success.
The target API version is 2025-03-31.basil; account, webhook and request overrides remain unverified. SDK removal and API availability are assessed separately.
RawRequest with a pinned pre-Basil API version is a documented transitional path; absence of SDK helpers does not mean every historical usage-record request is unavailable.
